ASSA Advocate for the Petitioner : Joshim Uddin Ahmed, MR Z RAHMAN,MS J YESMIN Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM, MR. F A HASSAN (R-2)
 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI  ORDER Date : 14.08.2024 Heard Mr. H.R.A.Choudhury, learned Sr. counsel assisted by Mr. Z. Rahman,
learned counsel appearing for the accused petitioners.

Also heard Mr. D. P. Goswami, learned Addl.
P.P., Assam appearing for the State respondent No.1.
None has appeared on behalf of the respondent No.2

By filing this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioners, namely,
(1) Asim Uddin @ Ashim Uddin @ Habijul (2) Rahim Uddin @ Rohim Uddin and (3) Abdur Rashid @ Abdul Rashid, have prayed for grant of bail in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.121/2022 under Sections 365/376/379/506/34 of IPC R/W Section 4 of POCSO Act,
corresponding in GR Case No. 5760/2021 arising out of (Barpeta PS Case No. 2465/2021 under Section 365/376/379/506/34 of IPC, R/W Section Page No.# 3/4 4 of POCSO Act, 2012).
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the accused petitioners have been languishing in judicial custody for last 37 days since their arrest on 08.07.2024.

It is further submitted that the main allegation is against petitioner No.1 and there is no allegation against the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 as they only helped the petitioner No.1 in committing the offence.
He further submitted that as the charge-sheet has been laid, bail may be granted considering the length of detention.

Mr. R. J. Baruah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that the main allegation is against the petitioner No.1 and made no objection in granting bail to the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3.

2
I have heard the learned counsel for both the parties and perused the trial court record which reveals that charge-sheet has been laid against the accused petitioners.
From the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. it reveals that the victim has been sexually abused by the petitioner No.1.
In view of the submission of learned counsel for both the parties and considering the length of detention, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3.

Accordingly, the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3, named above, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- each with two suitable sureties each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Barpeta.

The direction for bail is further subject to the conditions that the petitioner Nos. 2 and 3:
(a) shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of learned Special Judge (POCSO),
Barpeta without prior written permission from him/her, till disposal of the case.

Page No.# 4/4 (b) shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
Bail of petitioner No.1 may be considered after recording the evidence of the victim in the trial court.
Registry is directed to procure the evidence of witnesses recorded so far.

List the matter after 2(two)
weeks.
